summary: Optimi Health Corp. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 22, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. Michael Blough as Chief Clinical Development Officer, a newly created executive role. The appointment is a routine, planned hire rather than a forced or abrupt departure; no stake, price, premium, or transaction terms are stated. Dr. Blough will oversee clinical development strategy, including a planned Phase 2 psilocybin trial in major depressive disorder and a Phase 3 MDMA trial in PTSD, both expected to begin enrolling patients next year. No board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle applies.
